Abraham

Please help support the mission of New Advent and get the full contents of this website as an instant download.

Abraham was the first patriarch and father of the Hebrew people, who flourished about 2000 B.C.

The name Abraham, in Hebrew Avraham, means "father of many nations" according to the text of Genesis 17:5.
